pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah.
   C. Say Surah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

3. Which response best shows understanding of Toileting? (1 mark)
   A. Use Toileting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Toileting.
   C. Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Toileting has no place in daily life.

4. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Eid? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Eid.
   B. Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Eid has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Eid to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Belief in Allah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah.
   D. Use Belief in Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   D. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in His and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Toileting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

4. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

6. B — Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A — Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Belief in His; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pillars of Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Toileting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
